_what: The most findings each check may report before CI calls it a regression.
_why: This repo has a real flake8/mypy backlog. A pipeline that fails on all of it is red on its first run and every run after, and a check that is always red is one people stop reading. Deleting the backlog to go green would be worse: silencing tools rather than answering them. So every check that is clean today is pinned at zero and may never regress, and the two with a backlog are pinned at exactly what they report now.
_rule: THIS NUMBER ONLY EVER GOES DOWN. Fix findings and lower it in the same change; never raise it to make a build pass.
_run:
python lint.py            -- the full list, for a person
python lint.py --ceiling  -- the ratchet, for CI
_machine: The counts are CI's, under the vehicle's python (3.11 — checks.yml says why). flake8 and mypy both count differently under other interpreters (3.14 reports 8 more E231-family findings and 1 fewer mypy error from the same tree), so a desk on a newer python reading CEILING EXCEEDED against these numbers may be measuring its interpreter, not a regression: check what CI says before touching the ceiling.
